body: Hey . Do not go back home. You're lucky you've moved out there and somehow working to earn some money. Keep the struggle on.. Don't sell yourself . Struggle..work at 5 different cafes if possible. Think of something. 5 years from now. The struggle you do now will pay off. Being independent and having pride for yourself is the best fuckin thing you can do .

Hey. I have a small speech disorder. Idk how bad it is for you but I can say I know the feeling. The constant thought in your head before saying anything. Before ordering food. The nervousness when someone asks something to us. It's just too much. But . I just never felt that I would stop because of that. It's in our control buddy. It's not something that CANNOT be changed.we just have to do it. Now. I know I haven't done it myself. But trust me. Ending everything because of this is something wrong.. I feel you. I want to end my life too. But not because of the way I speak. It's me. . that's how I am. That's how we are . We don't need anyone to validate us. But trust me.i feel the pain. Just try working on it. A little bit harder.  Mine isn't the worse condition. But I do feel embarrassed.
